raw.comments:
Edit only Tablet/PowerCopiedSupport.tex. Preserve the Lean statement, imports, and support DAG; do not add a helper. At depth zero, expand 
oderef{PowerCopiedLeft} to show that L_{n,0} is the canonical response to the initial pair, and cite 
oderef{PowerIResponseLegal} for \mathsf{PowerMove}(h(\mathsf{PowerShiftIter}(n,x)),L_{n,0}); do not infer this initial move from 
oderef{PowerCopiedFailureMove}, whose statement only concerns L_{n,k} to L_{n,k+1}. At successor depth k+1, cite 
oderef{PowerCopiedFailureMove} at depth k for \mathsf{PowerMove}(L_{n,k},L_{n,k+1}), apply 
oderef{PowerMoveInSupport}, and compose with the induction hypothesis. Keep the row/index notation and the paper's recursive support argument explicit. No statement/import/support changes.

paper_focus_ranges.reason: The paper treats Q-elements as atoms and defines support recursively, motivating the explicit move-by-move support induction.

paper_grounding.basis_summary: Lines 1368-1374 define the atom singleton support clause and the node support as the union of child supports. The copied-value support proof should therefore establish each legal move from the exact cited move statements before applying this recursive support argument.
